title: SolarWinds Orion Platform UpdateActionsProperties Incorrect Comparison Remote Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on affected installations of SolarWinds Orion Platform. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the UpdateActionsProperties method. The issue results from an incorrect string comparison. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to execute code in the context of NETWORK SERVICE.
